nodes.description: Tyr454His (heptad position d), Leu458Phe and Leu458Pro (position a) and an in-frame insertion of a histidine in the same segment. These lie in the last eight residues of coil 2 (Thr453 to Gly460). In homologous keratin heterodimer crystal structures the counterpart of Tyr454 contacts the type II partner in most chains, while the last turn carrying Leu458 is packed in some structures and frayed in others; the segment's role is thought to be the end-to-end overlap of molecules during filament elongation. Leu458Pro gave more severe disease than Leu458Phe in the reporting families.

nodes.description: Keratin 9 is a structural protein. Its central rod domain (residues 153 to 465 of the 623-residue chain) forms a parallel coiled coil with a type II keratin, and these heterodimers assemble into the keratin filaments of the suprabasal palmoplantar keratinocyte. Disease variants are heterozygous missense or small in-frame changes at the two ends of the rod: the helix initiation segment at the start of coil 1A (Met157, Leu160, Asn161, Arg163, Tyr167, Leu168, Val171, Gln172) and the helix termination segment at the end of coil 2 (Tyr454, Leu458, and a histidine insertion beside His455). Arg163, the counterpart of keratin 14 Arg125 and keratin 10 Arg156, accounts for about half of reported families. The mutant chain is stable and is built into filaments alongside the wild-type chain, where it interferes with assembly. The effect on the gene's function is therefore a loss of normal keratin 9 filament function produced by a dominant-negative protein, not a reduction in the amount of protein and not a new activity.

nodes.description: Same residue as Arg163Trp. The glutamine substitution removes the charge while keeping a polar side chain. nodes.description: Coil 1A helix initiation segment, heptad position g. Arg163 is identical in all 28 human type I keratins and aligns with keratin 14 Arg125 and keratin 10 Arg156, the hotspots of epidermolysis bullosa simplex and epidermolytic ichthyosis. The codon is a CpG site, which explains its recurrence. Substitutions at codon 163 account for 48 of 100 published families. Replacing the charged, flexible arginine with a bulky aromatic side chain at a position that flanks the hydrophobic seam of the coiled coil is expected to disturb the first turns of the dimer, where filament elongation contacts form.

nodes.description: Asn161Lys, Ser, Ile, Tyr and His. Coil 1A, heptad position e, identical in all 28 human type I keratins.
